::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## What the symbols mean

| Symbol | Meaning |
|:------:|:--------|
| $x$ | The **base**: the number being multiplied |
| $a$, $b$ | **Exponents**: how many times the base is multiplied by itself |
| $x^a$ | "$x$ to the $a$": $x$ multiplied by itself $a$ times |
| $x^0$ | Any nonzero base to the 0 power is $1$ |
| $x^{-a}$ | $\frac{1}{x^a}$: a negative exponent flips the power into a fraction |
:::
